Editorial policy

Publication frequency, review model, author format, fee-free publishing, and CC BY licensing have been approved by the publisher. Submissions open after OJS activation.

Publication ethics

Authors are responsible for original work, accurate data, and proper attribution. Fabrication, falsification, plagiarism, and duplicate submission conflict with the proposed editorial principles.

Editors should assess scholarly quality and scope fit. Reviewers keep manuscripts confidential, provide reasoned feedback, and do not use unpublished material for personal benefit.

Peer review

Each eligible manuscript is assessed by two reviewers through double-anonymous peer review. Author and reviewer identities are concealed during review as far as practical. The handling editor selects reviewers for relevant expertise and absence of competing interests.

Initial screening checks scope, completeness, originality, and readiness for review. Reviewers assess the research question, methods, evidence, integration across perspectives, and contribution. The handling editor is responsible for the final decision.

Decisions include rejection, revision, further review, and acceptance. Authors provide a point-by-point response to reviews. Submission or revision does not guarantee acceptance; no fixed decision time is promised.

When an author is a journal editor or staff member, an independent handling editor must oversee screening, reviewer selection, and decisions. The author takes no part in their own editorial assessment.

Authorship

Authorship should reflect substantive scholarly contributions. All authors approve the manuscript and remain accountable for their contributions. Other assistance may be acknowledged with permission.

Changes to authorship or order require an explanation and agreement from affected contributors. Unresolved disputes may require clarification from the relevant institutions.

Competing interests

Authors, editors, and reviewers disclose financial, professional, or personal relationships that may affect judgement. Funding sources and funder involvement should be stated.

Conflicted editors or reviewers should withdraw from handling. Papers involving editorial-board members are handled by another independent editor.

Originality & similarity

Textual similarity should be assessed in context rather than by a single percentage. Quotations, methods, standard terminology, and reuse of an author’s work need editorial judgement. No numerical threshold or tool is prescribed in this preview.

Suspected misconduct should prompt requests for explanations and supporting materials, assessment of evidence, and an opportunity to respond before a decision.

Research ethics & data

Research involving people should explain consent, confidentiality, and ethical review relevant to its design and context. Include an applicable ethics approval identifier where available.

Sensitive data should not be disclosed merely to meet an openness expectation. Explain access restrictions, anonymisation, and limitations arising from participant consent.

Use of AI

disclose AI use affecting writing, analysis, images, or research, including its purpose and affected parts. Authors remain responsible for all content, sources, and accuracy.

AI is not listed as an author. Authors and reviewers must not upload confidential manuscripts or participant data to AI services without appropriate permission.

Access & licensing

The journal adopts open access. Published articles are made available under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Authors retain copyright and grant the journal the right of first publication.

The licence permits sharing and adaptation, including for commercial purposes, provided appropriate credit is given, a licence link is included, and changes are indicated. Material credited to third parties may carry separate terms.

Read the complete licence terms at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Manuscript previews remain clearly labelled and do not imply editorial acceptance. The current site is private while it is being prepared; public access will be configured at launch.

Publication fees

There are no submission fees, article processing charges, publication charges, or author fees for the journal’s editorial and publication process.

Editorial decisions are independent of payment. This website does not collect payments.

Corrections & retractions

errors affecting interpretation should be addressed through a correction linked to the article. Serious reliability concerns may require an expression of concern or retraction after evidence assessment and communication with affected parties.

The publication record should remain traceable; substantive changes should not be silent. Operational procedures and responsibilities remain to be set.

Complaints & appeals

Authors may raise concerns through the official editorial contact with reasons and evidence. Appeals should identify procedural or scholarly issues rather than only disagreement with an outcome.

Independent handling without competing interests is proposed. A dedicated email, process, and response times remain to be announced. Interim telephone contact: 081789825757.

Privacy & preservation

This preview does not provide account registration, manuscript uploads, or payments. Theme preferences are stored locally in the browser; the selected language applies during the visit. Fonts load from Fontshare. Private access uses the hosting provider’s authentication.

The OJS service will use author and reviewer information for editorial administration and correspondence. Access must be limited to authorised editorial personnel and technical administrators. A retention schedule and data-request email must be configured before account registration opens.

Backups must cover the database, private manuscript files, public assets, and configuration. A restoration check is required before launch. No participation in a long-term preservation service is claimed until that service is active.
